name: Evrosia
summary: Evrosia is defined by sculptural clarity and quiet strength. Its surface, wrapped in refined ceramic, rests upon panels and a base finished in a soft gray tone, creating a seamless interplay of texture and form. The painted metal frame lends architectural precision, while the composition as a whole embodies balance, modernity, and enduring elegance.
